title: Progress on my game, working name: "Trading Blows"
author: Tom_Baron
selftext:
About a month into my hobby project now. Coined it Trading Blows initially but I'm still unsure about the name.

Its a strategy heavy turn based war game, you control a city in a war between two sides, up to 30v30 players. A modern war conducted by missiles and drones. 

At a tactical level, you can outsmart your nearest neighbours by exposing underdefended key buildings, changing the bearings of your strikes, concentrating or scattering strikes depending on how they have set up. Action points and planning let you develop your city, build munitions and repair buildings, if you dont spend wisely, damage snowballs and your city can get beyond repair and become an easy target for your enemies

  
At a strategic level, you can ship defences and/or missiles to team members in hotspots, you can deploy stances in your city to give you highly enhanced offensive or defensive abilities, either imparting a passing gift of an enormous attack to an enemy or trying to turtle multiple cities attacks  to waste their resources. 

  
There is no regeneration or take over, if your city is bombed into ruin, you are OUT. However, your participation isnt over. You become part of the intelligence layer. You can see all the intel gathered on opposing cities by your sides use of recon drones, you can coordinate shipments of air defences and weapons on behalf of your team, analyse opposing cities for unprotected buildings then instruct your team to launch their ICBMs!



Ive done a fair bit of work on graphics, using WebGL and mcps to blender and meshy. A first iteration of damage is in the video above. Ive iterated for hours about the layered gameplay with astra, the strategic layer was envisioned in that conversation, passed to codex for documenting how it was to be applied technically to game, reviewed, then finally Opus 5.5 picked up the vision and application documents and wrote the code. 

Now its sitting in my early iteration stage where I'm looking for low hanging fruit for balancing and obvious gameplay holes. I expect this will take a couple of weeks. I'm using headless testing on my game engine, real game play and watching game simulations played between two teams of bots

Simultaneously whilst working on balancing, I'm running the same process above for UI development. This will be the fourth and largest redesign so far I think. There are elements of the strategic layer I cannot monitor easily until this is complete so balancing and tuning especially weapon/defence transfer will largely wait till this is done.

I dont have a deadline for this, itll be ready when I'm happy everything is working how I intend it to!

comments.author: damocles_paw
comments.body: "Trading Blows" is a very good name for this. A big visual problem is that the explosion effects don't shake with the city, so it looks like the screen is damaged and smeared. You should have caught that and fixed it before posting.

replies.author: Tom_Baron
replies.body: Ive seen so many explosions as the graphics have developed ive gone blind to the detail and not picked this up, probably a glitch in a later change.  So no, im definately happy i posted it because you added genuinely handy feedback! So thanks a lot!

replies.author: Tom_Baron
replies.body: Also thanks for the name compliment. Maybe it isnt as weak as i thought
